sections.heading: 1. Knee rocks
lines: ① Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
② Let both knees sway slowly side to side.
③ 10 each way, 2–3 times a day.
④ Add a 10–20 min walk most days.

slides.title:
Back on your mind?
Meet Hybi at Hybrid Physio!

caption:
Sore back, so you stay on the couch all weekend? Back pain guidelines actually start with reassurance and staying active. Walking and normal daily activity, adjusted to comfort, usually help more than bed rest.

Without warning signs, routine X-rays or MRI often aren't needed. Spinal manipulation and mobilisation are listed as options for some people, usually alongside exercise and advice rather than on their own.

Numbness around the groin, leg weakness or bladder and bowel changes need prompt medical attention. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio work alongside our physios. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
